description.en: The alias of the vulnerability to query.
The ID of the container cluster.
The name of the cluster.
The ID of the container.

description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The page number of the page to return in a paginated query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh:
漏洞是否已处理。取值：
- **y**：已处理
- **n**：未处理
description.en:
Specifies whether the vulnerability has been handled. Valid values:
- **y**: handled
- **n**: not handled.
The unique identifier of the container image.
The name of the container image.
The ID of the asset instance.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type of the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.
The name of the vulnerability to query.
The namespace.

description.zh:
漏洞修复必要性等级。取值：
- **asap**：需尽快修复（通常是高危漏洞）
- **later**：可延后修复（通常是中危漏洞）
- **nntf**：暂可不修复（通常是低危漏洞）
description.en:
The priority level of vulnerability fixing. Valid values:
- **asap**: high-priority vulnerability
- **later**: medium-priority vulnerability
- **nntf**: low-priority vulnerability.

description.zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的漏洞的数量。默认值为**10**，表示每页显示10条漏洞。
description.en: Settings for the number of vulnerabilities to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates that 10 vulnerabilities are displayed on each page.
The pod.

The instance ID of the container image repository.
The name of the container image repository.

description.zh: 容器镜像仓库的命名空间。
description.en: The namespace of the container image repository.
The region ID of the container image repository.

description.zh:
漏洞标签，取值：

- **AI**： AI组件相关漏洞
description.en:
The vulnerability tag. Valid values:

- **AI**: vulnerability related to AI components.
The collection of scan ranges.

description.zh:
漏洞的修复状态。取值：
- **1**：未修复
- **4**：修复中
- **7**：修复成功
description.en:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Valid values:
- **1**: unfixed
- **4**: being fixed
- **7**: fixed.
The tag of the container image.

description.zh: 要查询的漏洞的类型。固定取值为**cve**，表示查询容器镜像漏洞。
description.en: The type of vulnerability to query. Set the value to **cve**, which indicates container image vulnerabilities.

description.zh: 资产实例的UUID列表。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The UUIDs of asset instances. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

title.zh: 查看容器镜像漏洞列表

descriptions.zh: 如果您需要查看最新的容器镜像漏洞信息，您可以先调用[PublicCreateImageScanTask](~~PublicCreateImageScanTask~~)接口创建镜像扫描任务，等待1~5分钟后，再调用当前接口查看容器镜像漏洞列表。
descriptions.en: To view the latest container image vulnerability information, call the [PublicCreateImageScanTask](~~PublicCreateImageScanTask~~) operation to create an image scan task first, wait 1 to 5 minutes, and then call this operation to view the container image vulnerability list.
